verdict.rationale: Docs show an API-first architecture (applicant creation, workflow runs, SDK tokens, webhooks with HMAC-signed payloads, and polling) that returns structured Document, Facial Similarity, Watchlist and Known Faces reports an automated system could branch on, and OAuth/webhook mechanics support headless integration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of granular risk-score/reason-code fields or sample JSON schemas showing failure reason enumerations, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of how fine-grained the machine-readable outputs are.
